property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer always calls the callee's transferFrom(address,uint256) ABI (i.e., the helper's transferFrom function is invoked for each _tos entry and records the decoded args); the mutant changes the selector to approve(address,uint256) so a recording helper will observe different selector/decoded calldata for some inputs, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Change the selector hashed to a different function name so external calls target a different selector, potentially changing observable effects while keeping return true.
